A.description: Same original materials and task; executor writes a free description without B-derived skill rules or prompts.

B.description: Same original materials and task; fixed project skill with rule, entity and reference bindings.

field_contracts.record_template: Copy into records only for an assigned real experimental unit. Replace required identifiers and choose condition A/B and cohort ai_proxy/human_team. Do not count this template itself.
field_contracts.execution_status: not_run, completed, failed or incomplete. not_run requires attempts=[]; failed/incomplete remain in the attempted denominator.
field_contracts.attempt_template: Append only after an actual generation/edit attempt. Use contiguous integers starting at 1; preserve failures with artifact_path=null. Do not append planned retries.
field_contracts.attempt_type: Record generation, tool_edit or manual_edit as actually performed. Do not imply that all revisions consume identical time or budget.
field_contracts.all_outputs: Record every returned file with path and sha256. artifact_path identifies the output actually reviewed under the predeclared selection policy, not an undisclosed best-of batch.
field_contracts.actual_reference_inputs: Each entry: reference_id, source_material_id, path, sha256, role, entity_id, input_method, tool_receipt_path, delivery_verified (true/false/null). This is actual input evidence, not planned references.
field_contracts.review_evidence: Each entry: criterion, rule_id, result pass/fail/unknown, source_evidence_location, output_region, observation, correction and reviewer_id. Do not invent observations for missing images.
field_contracts.technical_measurements: Each entry: requirement_id, required_value, measured_value, tool_or_method, evidence_path and result pass/fail/unknown. Engine readiness requires actual checks appropriate to the declared task stage.
field_contracts.review: Missing criteria are unknown. All required criteria must pass and an artifact must exist for a first-pass success; later success cannot rewrite attempt 1.
field_contracts.settings: Record actual tool/model/version/seed/parameters; unknown or unsupported values are null with a reason, not guessed recipe defaults.
field_contracts.fairness: Use matched, mismatched or unknown with evidence. AI proxy and human team results must remain separate; descriptive differences do not establish causation.
field_contracts.approval: No automatic approval is inferred. Use existing human user authorization and actual decision evidence; AI review alone is not an art-director approval.
